strings.d1.s0.name: Nevsky Prospekt
strings.d1.s0.tips: A 4.5 km main boulevard. Look out for the Kazan Cathedral colonnade and the Singer building (Dom Knigi bookshop).
strings.d1.s1.name: Kazan Cathedral
strings.d1.s1.tips: A colonnade modelled on St Peter's. Free entry; Kutuzov's tomb is inside.
strings.d1.s2.name: Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood
strings.d1.s2.tips: A Russian-style church with 7,000 m² of mosaics, built where Alexander II was assassinated. Closed Wednesdays; buy tickets online.
strings.d1.s3.name: Pyshechnaya Bolshaya Konyushennaya
strings.d1.s3.tips: A Soviet pyshki (ring doughnut) shop since 1958. Expect a queue; cash only.
strings.d1.s4.name: Russian Museum
strings.d1.s4.tips: The largest collection of Russian art, with Repin and Aivazovsky's The Ninth Wave. Closed Tuesdays.
strings.d1.b0.name: Stolle Pirogi Nevsky
strings.d1.b0.tips: Russian pies (pirogi). A chain, but a good one.
strings.d1.b1.name: Griboyedov Canal behind Kazan Cathedral
strings.d1.b1.tips: A walk along the canal bank, in place of the garden.
strings.d2.s0.name: Palace Square
strings.d2.s0.tips: The Alexander Column and the General Staff arch, in front of the Winter Palace.
strings.d2.s1.name: State Hermitage Museum
strings.d2.s1.tips: The Winter Palace and 3 million works: Rembrandt, Da Vinci, the Raphael Loggias, and the Peacock Clock at 12:00. Book a timed ticket online; closed Mondays; allow 4 hours.
strings.d2.s2.name: Hermitage Cafeteria
strings.d2.s2.tips: The cafeteria inside the museum: a quick lunch without leaving.
strings.d2.s3.name: General Staff Building Hermitage
strings.d2.s3.tips: Impressionists (Monet, Matisse, Picasso), across the square. Combined ticket 1,400.
strings.d2.s4.name: Admiralty Embankment Walk
strings.d2.s4.tips: Along the Neva, with views of the Bronze Horseman and the dome of St Isaac's.
strings.d2.b0.name: Teremok Nevsky
strings.d2.b0.tips: A blini (crepe) chain: cheap and quick.
strings.d2.b1.name: Winter Palace of Peter I
strings.d2.b1.tips: Remains of Peter's first palace, instead of the General Staff Building.
strings.d3.s0.name: Peterhof Lower Park
strings.d3.s0.tips: The fountains are off from mid-October to April. In winter the park is free and the cascade statues are covered, so the palace is the main draw.
strings.d3.s1.name: Peterhof Grand Palace
strings.d3.s1.tips: Rastrelli's golden halls. Timed tickets; closed Mondays.
strings.d3.s2.name: Peterhof Shtandart Restaurant
strings.d3.s2.tips: A Russian restaurant next to the park: borscht and pelmeni.
strings.d3.s3.name: Alexandria Park Peterhof
strings.d3.s3.tips: The gulf shore in winter, with ice.
strings.d3.b0.name: Peterhof Bolshoy Cafe
strings.d3.b0.tips: A cheap cafe in the town.
strings.d3.b1.name: Monplaisir Palace
strings.d3.b1.tips: Peter's seaside pavilion, instead of Alexandria.
strings.d4.s0.name: Peter and Paul Fortress
strings.d4.s0.tips: The island where the city was born. The cathedral holds the Romanov tombs, the cannon fires at 12:00, and the beach gives a view of the city.
strings.d4.s1.name: Petrovsky Cafe in the Fortress
strings.d4.s1.tips: A cafe inside the fortress for lunch.
strings.d4.s2.name: Rostral Columns Strelka
strings.d4.s2.tips: The Vasilyevsky Island spit, with the columns and a panorama of the Neva.
strings.d4.s3.name: Kunstkamera
strings.d4.s3.tips: Peter's 1714 museum of curiosities. Closed Mondays.
strings.d4.s4.name: Vasilyevsky Lines Walk
strings.d4.s4.tips: Streets numbered as "lines", and the Andreyevsky market.
strings.d4.b0.name: Erarta Museum
strings.d4.b0.tips: Contemporary Russian art on Vasilyevsky Island, instead of the Kunstkamera.
strings.d4.b1.name: Marketplace Vasilyevsky
strings.d5.s0.name: Catherine Palace
strings.d5.s0.tips: 45 minutes by train and bus or by taxi (Tsarskoye Selo). See the Amber Room and the Great Hall; timed tickets sell out online.
strings.d5.s1.name: Catherine Park
strings.d5.s1.tips: The park in winter: snow and ice on the lake.
strings.d5.s2.name: Podvorye Restaurant, Pushkin
strings.d5.s2.tips: Decorated like a Russian village house, and a restaurant Putin has eaten at. Blini and meat dishes.
strings.d5.s3.name: Alexander Palace
strings.d5.s3.tips: The last Tsar's home, with restored private rooms.
strings.d5.b0.name: Pavlovsk Palace
strings.d5.b0.tips: The neighbouring Pavlovsk palace and its huge park, instead of the Alexander Palace.
strings.d5.b1.name: Beliy Medved Cafe, Pushkin
strings.d5.b1.tips: Good value in the town centre.
strings.d6.s0.name: Saint Isaac's Cathedral
strings.d6.s0.tips: A huge golden dome. Climb the colonnade: 262 steps (extra charge) for a city panorama. Closed Wednesdays.
strings.d6.s1.name: Bronze Horseman
strings.d6.s1.tips: The statue of Peter the Great on Senate Square.
strings.d6.s2.name: Yusupov Palace
strings.d6.s2.tips: The palace where Rasputin was killed, with a private theatre and a basement scene. Audio guide.
strings.d6.s3.name: Sadko Restaurant Mariinsky
strings.d6.s3.tips: Russian cuisine next to the Mariinsky: a classic before the theatre.
strings.d6.s4.name: Neva and Canal Boat Tour
strings.d6.s4.tips: Daytime canal tour (May to October). In winter the canals are frozen; a bus tour is the alternative.
strings.d6.b0.name: Mariinsky Theatre
strings.d6.b0.tips: A ballet or opera evening. Buy tickets online weeks ahead (prices are higher for tourists).
strings.d6.b1.name: Marketplace Isaac
strings.d7.theme: Summer Garden and a gentle farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Summer Garden
strings.d7.s0.tips: In winter the statues are boxed up. Walk along the Neva.
strings.d7.s1.name: Fabergé Museum
strings.d7.s1.tips: Nine imperial eggs in the Shuvalov Palace, on the Fontanka.
strings.d7.s2.name: Yeliseyev Emporium
strings.d7.s2.tips: A luxury 1903 Art Nouveau food hall. Cake and champagne at the cafe corner; good for gifts.
strings.d7.s3.name: Moskovsky Station / Pulkovo Bus
strings.d7.s3.tips: To the airport: Moskovskaya metro plus bus 39, 60 minutes. Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Cafe Singer Dom Knigi
strings.d7.b0.tips: A bookshop cafe with a view of Kazan Cathedral.
strings.d7.b1.name: Anna Akhmatova Museum
strings.d7.b1.tips: The poet's apartment in the Fountain House, instead of Fabergé.
strings.note0: Metro token or Podorozhnik card (~70 RUB); the metro is deep. Pulkovo Airport: Moskovskaya metro plus bus 39. Use the Yandex Go app for taxis.
strings.note1: Winter brings -5 to -15°C and 6 hours of daylight; museums are quiet, the Neva is frozen, and there are New Year decorations from December to January. In autumn, September to October, the parks turn gold.
strings.note2: Visa: Turkish citizens get 60 days visa-free; others need an e-visa. Visa/Mastercard DO NOT WORK (since 2022), so bring cash RUB or Mir/UnionPay. A Turkish Ziraat card sometimes works, but bring cash.
strings.note3: Hermitage 1,000 RUB (timed, online), Catherine Palace 2,200, Peterhof park 1,500 plus palace 2,000, Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood 550. Closed days: Hermitage and Peterhof on Mondays, the Savior on Spilled Blood and St Isaac's on Wednesdays, the Russian Museum on Tuesdays.
strings.note4: Borscht, pelmeni, blini, pyshki. Business lunch (biznes-lanch) 12:00-16:00 costs ~500 RUB; tip 10%.
strings.note5: Keep your passport on you; hotels handle registration (registratsiya). Yandex Maps is more accurate than Google Maps.
